description: A resource (VM, automation account, logic app) runs as a service principal / managed identity you can drive.

telemetry.detail: Managed-identity / service-principal sign-in appears in the SP sign-in logs.
Azure Activity log: Resource action that invokes the identity (run-command, job start) is logged. (default-on).
Microsoft Defender for Cloud can alert on anomalous managed-identity resource actions (Defender for Resource Manager/Servers); requires the paid plan + onboarded resource.

prerequisite_privilege: Control over the resource that carries the managed identity
abuse_primitive: Execute on the resource to obtain a token for its managed identity, then act as that SP.
notes: Managed-identity token requests are quiet; the SP's subsequent actions are where detection lands.
